content.text: {"answer":"Aggregate capital of $25 million or more in the Flagship Fund and the Offshore Fund (together with affiliates' capital) as of the first day of a calendar quarter qualifies for the Large Investor Rate of 1.50% per annum, effective for fee periods beginning on or after October 1, 2026 (reduced from the prior $50 million threshold).","source_document":"06_policy_update_memo.md","section":"Section 2.6 (Fee Schedule Section 2.2 (Large Investor Rate))","quote":"The aggregate capital threshold for the Large Investor Rate is reduced from $50 million to $25 million. For fee periods beginning on or after October 1, 2026, the Large Investor Rate of 1.50% per annum applies to the entire Class A capital account of an investor whose aggregate capital in the Flagship Fund and the Offshore Fund, together with the capital of its affiliates, is $25 million or more as of the first day of a calendar quarter."}
